# Slab spanning the whole sealed room in Y: x in [-2, 2], y in [-128, 128],
# z in [0, 128]. The +Y face (y = 128) is hint — coincident with the room
# wall's own plane — and the rest are skip.
brush room-hint-on-wall
face -1 0 0 2 tools/toolsskip
face 1 0 0 2 tools/toolsskip
face 0 -1 0 128 tools/toolsskip
face 0 1 0 128 tools/toolshint
face 0 0 -1 0 tools/toolsskip
face 0 0 1 128 tools/toolsskip
